usdRate.sourceName: BCEAO, rates of foreign currencies against the CFA franc for transfers, 30 October 2026
usdRate.note: Mid-point of the buying (585.50) and selling (592.50) rates for the US dollar; the CFA franc is pegged at 655.957 per euro. World Bank 2025 average 581.9. The page is updated daily; on 2 November 2026 it showed 582.50 buying and 589.50 selling (mid 586).

inflation_cpi.sourceName: BCEAO, monthly economic note for UMOA countries, September 2026 (harmonised consumer prices, August 2026)
inflation_cpi.note: Consumer prices up 3.0% year on year in Burkina in August 2026 after 2.3% in July (INSD data via BCEAO); 2025 average -0.6% (World Bank).

inflation_projection.sourceName: BCEAO inflation target (1-3% band, centre 2%); Burkina CPI 3.0% in August 2026
inflation_projection.note: Inflation swings with harvests but averages near the BCEAO band and the CFA franc is pegged to the euro, so the 2% centre of the 1-3% target band is used for long-range plans.

policy_rate.sourceName: BCEAO, monthly economic note for UMOA countries, September 2026 (Monetary Policy Committee of 9 September 2026)
policy_rate.note: Main policy rate (rate at which the BCEAO refinances banks) 3.00%, left unchanged by the 9 September 2026 committee; the marginal lending facility rate is 5.00%. Common to all eight UMOA countries. The previously cited BCEAO key-rates page now returns 404.

savings_account_rate.note: No average rate on ordinary savings accounts in Burkina was found; the BCEAO bank-conditions survey (first half 2026) lists term-deposit and contractual-savings rates only.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Burkina Faso)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Median of the minimum term-deposit rates (taux DAT minimum) that Burkina's banks declare to the BCEAO, range 2.0-4.5%; the minimum usually applies to small, short deposits. Not a tenor-specific average.

fdr_1y_rate.note: The BCEAO bank-conditions survey gives only minimum (median 3.5%) and maximum (median 6.5%, range 5.0-7.5%) term-deposit rates per bank in Burkina for the first half of 2026, not a 1-year rate.

dps_rate.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Burkina Faso)
dps_rate.note: Median rate on contractual savings plans (épargne contractuelle) declared by Burkina's banks in the first half of 2026; most declare 3.50% (range 3.5-5.0%).

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: BCEAO, monthly economic note for UMOA countries, September 2026 (bank deposit rates, July 2026)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average deposit rate across UMOA banks, 5.15% in July 2026 (5.12% in June); Burkina's rate fell 0.01 points in the month, but the BCEAO does not publish the country level in this note.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate sold to individuals was found; the Treasury borrows through UMOA-Titres auctions of 12-month bills and 3-7 year bonds, open to individuals through banks and brokers.

tbill_91d_rate.note: Burkina's Treasury issued only 12-month bills on the regional market in 2026 (last: 3.73% yield on 7 October 2026); no 3-month bill rate exists.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: UMOA-Titres, Burkina Treasury auction of 7 October 2026 (5-year bond)
tbond_5y_rate.note: Weighted average yield 7.44% on the 6.20% bond maturing 8 October 2031; the UMOA-Titres zero-coupon curve of 23 October 2026 gives 7.58% at 5 years.

tbond_10y_rate.note: Burkina has not auctioned bonds longer than 7 years since 2022 (7-year yield 7.39% on 7 October 2026); the UMOA-Titres curve's 10-year point (5.9% zero coupon) rests on few trades and is not used.

tax_bank_interest.note: The tax authority site could not be reached and PwC Tax Summaries has no Burkina Faso page, so the withholding rate on bank interest could not be confirmed.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists, and the tax treatment of interest on Burkina Treasury securities for individuals could not be confirmed from an official source.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: UMOA Council of Ministers, Decision No. 009 of 30 June 2017 on FGDR-UMOA contribution rates and compensation ceilings
deposit_insurance_limit.note: Deposits are guaranteed up to 1,400,000 FCFA per depositor per bank (300,000 FCFA at a microfinance institution) by the regional deposit guarantee fund; the decision dates from 2017 (older than 2025) and is still the one the fund publishes.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions débitrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Burkina Faso)
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Maximum lending rate (taux débiteur maximum) declared by most Burkina banks for the first half of 2026 (range 12-14% at banks); it applies to all bank credit, including cards. No card-specific rate is published.

equity_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO monthly economic note, September 2026 (regional stock exchange BRVM, deposit rates)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: regional (BRVM) equities return about the bank deposit rate, as in their weak 2016-2020 years.

equity_return_base.sourceName: BCEAO monthly economic note, September 2026; UMOA-Titres Burkina auction results
equity_return_base.note: Base case: about 3.5 points above after-tax term deposits and 1-year Treasury bills (about 4%), within the 4-point cap; the BRVM's equity capitalisation rose 65.7% in the year to August 2026 but its 10-year record is uneven.

equity_return_high.sourceName: BCEAO monthly economic note, September 2026 (BRVM market capitalisation)
equity_return_high.note: High case: the BRVM repeats a strong decade like 2023-2026.

gold_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO exchange rates (CFA franc pegged to the euro)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat gold in euro terms.

gold_return_base.sourceName: BCEAO exchange rates (CFA franc pegged at 655.957 per euro)
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run dollar gold trend of about 4% a year plus a small allowance for the euro-pegged franc weakening against the dollar.

gold_return_high.note: High case: strong gold years such as 2024-2025.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Burkina Faso)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: small term deposits or contractual savings at the 3.5% floor rate, less a possible tax on interest.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Burkina Faso)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: larger term deposits (median maximum 6.5%) or 1-year Treasury bills (3.7%) through a bank, less tax on interest, rounded down because the tax rate is unconfirmed.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: 3-5 year Treasury bonds at about 7%, less a possible tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: CIMA (the regional insurance regulator) and Burkina's insurance directorate publish no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio that could be found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Temporary death cover is sold under the CIMA code, but no published premium rates per 1,000 FCFA of cover by age were found from a public source.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay in Burkina Faso was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age were found from a public source.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Burkina Faso
oop_health_share.note: 43.8% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database); older than 2025, the latest available.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: BCEAO monthly economic note, September 2026; inflation assumption 2%
goal_inflation_health.note: No reliable national medical CPI series was read; private medical costs usually rise faster than general prices, so 1.5 points above the 2% inflation assumption.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: BCEAO monthly economic note, September 2026; inflation assumption 2%
goal_inflation_education.note: No reliable national education CPI series was read; private school fees usually rise faster than general prices, so 2 points above the 2% inflation assumption.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Burkina Faso

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; the page gives men and women only, so totals are the mean of the two.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 4.78 (2025, World Bank), 5.6 (2040) and 10.1 (2065, populationpyramid.net/burkina-faso/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: CNSS Burkina Faso, old-age pension (pension de vieillesse)
retirement_age_default.note: Pension age is set by decree by job category: 56 for manual workers, 58 for employees, 60 for supervisors and managers, 63 for doctors and university teachers; at least 15 years of contributions. 58 (employees) is used; no newer rule for people born after 1975 was found.

retirement_age_government.note: CARFO (the civil-service pension fund) describes the pension as due at the statutory age limit but does not state it, and the public service statute could not be read.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Burkina Faso)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: small term deposits or contractual savings at about 3.5%, less a possible tax on interest.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: UMOA-Titres, Burkina auction of 7 October 2026 (12-month bill 3.73%)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: about the 1-year Treasury bill yield (3.73%) and small term-deposit rates; not above the safe rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: UMOA-Titres, Burkina auction of 7 October 2026 (3-year bond 7.01%)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: part of the money in larger term deposits or short Treasury bonds.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Burkina Faso)
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: a mix earning about after-tax deposit rates.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: UMOA-Titres Burkina auction results; equity base 7.5%; gold base 4.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of deposits or Treasury bonds, regional equity funds and some gold.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: UMOA-Titres Burkina auction results; equity high 12%

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension for Burkina Faso was found; the CNSS and CARFO 'allocation de vieillesse' is a contributory lump sum for people with under 15 years of contributions, not a social pension.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found (see old_age_allowance_monthly).

gratuity_rule.note: No official text on a statutory end-of-service or retirement indemnity for private employees in Burkina Faso could be read (the Labour Code was not reached).

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: CNSS Burkina Faso, old-age pension (pension de vieillesse)
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory CNSS pension for private employees after at least 15 years of contributions, from 56, 58 or 60 depending on job category (58 used); voluntary insured persons from 56. The page gives no benefit formula or indexation rule, so inflationLinked is false (no automatic indexation found); a lump-sum allocation is paid to those with under 15 years.

fdr_3m.note: Banks declare minimum and maximum term-deposit rates to the BCEAO twice a year.

fdr_1y.note: Banks declare minimum and maximum term-deposit rates to the BCEAO twice a year.

dps.note: Monthly savings plans (housing or project savings) offered by banks.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: Burkina's Treasury issued only 12-month bills (bons assimilables du Trésor) on the regional market in 2026.

tbond_5y.note: Auctioned every two weeks by UMOA-Titres in 3, 5 and 7-year lines; individuals buy through banks or licensed brokers (SGI).

tbond_10y.note: No bond longer than 7 years has been auctioned since 2022.

equity_fund.note: Supervised by the regional financial market authority (AMF-UMOA); equity funds invest on the regional exchange (BRVM).

gold.note: Burkina is a gold producer; gold is mainly bought as jewellery, bars and coins are uncommon for savers.

centralBank.name: Banque Centrale des États de l'Afrique de l'Ouest (BCEAO)

insuranceRegulator.name: Commission Régionale de Contrôle des Assurances (CIMA)
insuranceRegulator.note: Regional insurance regulator for the CIMA member states; Burkina's insurance directorate is in the Ministry of Economy and Finance.

pensionScheme.name: Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS), old-age pension

depositInsurance.name: Fonds de Garantie des Dépôts et de Résolution dans l'UMOA (FGDR-UMOA)

statistics.name: Institut National de la Statistique et de la Démographie (INSD)
